geometry_source: SUMO plain XML generated by netconvert
description: SUMO road-network scenario with German right-hand traffic, a bicycle-only lane, two mixed-traffic lanes, and reproducible bicycle/vehicle interactions observed through TraCI.

scenarios.name: Bicycle-only interaction
scenarios.description: Two bicycles share the westbound bicycle-only lane; the faster bicycle starts 80 m behind and approaches the ego bicycle so the same-lane gap can be measured.

scenarios.name: Bicycle / car interaction
scenarios.description: A bicycle travels eastbound in the right mixed lane while a faster car approaches in the adjacent left mixed lane and passes on the left without entering the bicycle lane.

scenarios.name: Bicycle / motorbike interaction
scenarios.description: A bicycle travels westbound in the right mixed lane while a faster motorbike approaches in the adjacent left mixed lane and passes on the left without entering the bicycle lane.

scenarios.name: Bicycle / heavy-duty interaction
scenarios.description: A bicycle travels eastbound in the right mixed lane while a faster heavy-duty vehicle approaches in the adjacent left mixed lane and passes on the left without entering the bicycle lane.

scenarios.name: Berlin reference demand — multi-traffic
scenarios.description: 60-minute multi-agent SUMO run using a documented Berlin Frankfurter Allee traffic reference, downscaled by 0.10 for the compact validation corridor; incidents emerge from traffic rather than being prescribed.

traffic_reference.source: Berlin SenMVKU traffic-volume and bicycle-count reports

limitations: The bundled network is a controlled Berlin-anchored corridor generated from SUMO plain XML; it is not an OSM import or surveyed street network yet.
Bicycle-only lanes allow only the bicycle vehicle class; both mixed lanes allow bicycle, passenger car, motorcycle, and truck classes.
Interaction detection uses TraCI leader/follower state plus 2D vehicle-edge clearance; it is a simulation-derived proximity signal, not a calibrated physical passing-distance sensor measurement.
SUMO-generated acceleration and speed are simulation outputs, not physically calibrated IMU measurements.
The rule-based backend detector is unchanged and remains a demonstrator rather than a validated risk classifier.

The multi-traffic scenario uses Berlin Frankfurter Allee demand as a documented reference and applies a 0.10 scaling factor to fit the compact controlled corridor; this is not a claim that the corridor reproduces the full street.

The multi-traffic scenario uses explicit configurable 2% motorbike and 3% truck shares of Kfz pending a colocated Berlin vehicle-class breakdown; total Kfz and bicycle demand are the sourced quantities.
IDM is now configured for the multi-traffic experiment; it was not part of the original v5 controlled scenarios.
